_comment: Guest functions replaced by native code (src/game/overrides). The original is still compiled as f_<addr> and callable from the override.

overrides.why: pad_update: on the title (light ball, Press Start Button) any button also counts as Start (src/game/overrides/title_input.cpp)
task switch: saves context and jumps into another task's stack
task switch: sleep n frames (yield n times)
task switch: return address of every task entry; unlinks and switches away
file API: cache a directory for relative paths; served natively, no CD reads
file API: open X:\DIR\NAME.EXT via the archive tables; served natively
file API: read into RAM; native, instant (the original polls CdReadSync)
play movie N (0 opening, 1 credits, 2 BANDAI logo): native MPEG-1 from movie/movie<N>.mpg when present, else the CD stream
deck shuffle of player a0: skipped (only the pending count cleared) while the trainer's 'deck in order' is on for that player (src/game/overrides/battle.cpp)
battle DP of player a0: returns the value a battle hotkey locked (src/game/overrides/battle.cpp), else the original
text draw: ASCII strings take the US-renderer port, SJIS falls back to the JP original
text measure: same ASCII/SJIS dispatch as draw
condensed draw: ASCII takes the normal US port, SJIS the JP condensed original
condensed measure: same dispatch as condensed draw
libcd CdSearchFile: answered from the disc's root directory without reading it through the drive (the movie player looks up DIGIMON.MOV)
